Meta Releases Wonder, Opens Spark
Meta marched all the way back to the AI frontier to offer a Muse model for everyone: a high-end agentic model (comparable to Claude Sonnet 5.5) that costs $50 per month to access,
What’s new: Meta made three multimodal models ([link removed] )  available in one week, including the top-of-the-line Muse Wonder Full, the multimodal Muse Wonder, and the locally
- Input/output: Text, image, video, and audio in (up to 1 million tokens), text out (up to 128,000 tokens), 139 tokens/second (Muse Wonder) and 143 tokens/second (Muse Spark Open)
- Architecture: Mixture-of-experts transformer, 816 billion parameters, 42 billion active per token, 256 experts (Muse Spark Open)
- Performance: Tied for second on Artificial Analysis’ Intelligence Index (56, Muse Wonder Full); seventh (52, Muse Wonder); seventh among open weight models, first among U.S. open
- Availability: API and subscription (Muse Wonder), subscription only (Muse Wonder Full), weights ([link removed] )  available via Meta and Hugging Face (Muse Spark Open)
- Price: $4/$20 per 1M input/output tokens (Muse Wonder); $50/month (Muse Wonder Full); $1.25/$4.15 input/output (Muse Spark Open)
- Weights/license: Weights for Muse Spark Open available under the Muse Model license ([link removed] ) , which allows for commercial and noncommercial use for up to $20 million of
- Undisclosed: Knowledge cutoff, parameters and architecture for Muse Wonder models, specific training datasets and methods
How it works: Meta released a model card ([link removed] )  for Muse Wonder and Wonder Full, but it reveals very little about the model’s architecture or how it was trained.
